meta.author: claude
meta.description: Stone wall, straight, level 3 of 3: L2 plus flourish 3. Over budget: 66 blocks vs 60. 5 long stone wall on a battered cobblestone footing, crenellated parapet on corbels, 2-wide walk (stand at 5). Outside is the front (z 0). Merlons tile across joints: half merlon, crenel, merlon, crenel, merlon (the next module starts with its half merlon). Not yet builder-tested: iron_bars, moss_carpet, red_wall_banner, stone_brick_wall, vine. Decoration step adds: banner_pattern, item.
meta.changes: Quality check round 1: the merlon pattern changed across the whole set so modules tile end to end (a cobblestone-slab half merlon at x 0, merlons at x 2 and 4: neighbours now alternate high / low instead of two merlons side by side). Torches moved onto the merlons at x 2 and 4, the lamp post to x 3; the crenel fillers (slab, mossy wall) removed from L3, which gets more ivy and moss and an arrow barrel.
